text_block_list.name: Large Crowd
text_block_list.text: (Wooooooo~!)

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
(This dream again... So many people, all 
smiling...)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Today was the day of a fan meetup event 
with the horse girls. I had come to help 
out as staff, but—

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: I've moved the tables over.

text_block_list.name: Event Staff
text_block_list.text:
Wah! I'm so sorry, we shouldn't be making 
one of the performers help out!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Please don't worry about it. If there is 
anything else I can help with, just let me 
know.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Oh, where've ya been, Oguri? The show's 
about to start, so we gotta get on 
standby.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Sorry. I was just wondering if there was 
anything I could do to be of help.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
What's with that? Did ya have another 
dream tellin' ya to go help folks out or 
somethin'?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, apparently she sees 'em from time to 
time? Dreams where she's makin' a whole 
bunch of folks grin from ear to ear.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Come to think of it, when we bumped into 
each other in the mountains before, she 
mentioned having a dream where everyone 
was smiling—

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Ya even volunteered for this fan meetup 
yerself, didn'tcha! Wantin' to bring joy 
to everyone—now that's real stylish of ya!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seemed Oguri Cap had put quite a lot of 
effort into this fan meetup. Just then—

text_block_list.name: Event Organizer
text_block_list.text:
I am so sorry to keep you waiting! We've 
run into some trouble with the schedule 
adjustments...

text_block_list.name: Event Organizer
text_block_list.text:
Actually, because your appearance 
generated so much buzz, far more guests 
showed up than we ever anticipated.

text_block_list.name: Event Organizer
text_block_list.text:
At this rate, we have no choice but to 
implement admission restrictions...

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Guh~! Don't wanna turn folks away, but we 
can't let anything happen to the audience 
either.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Can't be helped, live events are 
unpredictable like that. Guess all we can 
do is give 'em a sincere apology.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
...I have a suggestion. How about 
splitting the fan meetup into two 
sessions?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Of course, since it was my idea, I will do 
the talk, the live performance, and the 
handshake event twice.
choice_data_list: Won't that be exhausting for you?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I don't mind. Seeing everyone rejoicing in 
my dream... I want to see that in reality, 
too.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Ever since I started having that dream, 
every time I see someone smile, it reminds 
me of it—

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
And that made me realize. That dream isn't 
some mysterious vision sent by someone 
else.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Everyone's smiles—that is my own wish. 
Rather than seeing someone sad, I want to 
see them happy.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
*sigh* There's no helpin' ya. If Oguri 
wants to do it so bad she's dreamin' about 
it, we've got no choice but to back her 
up!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry. I didn't even ask about your 
schedules, Tama, Inari.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Get outta here with that! No need to stand 
on ceremony with us! Organizer, we're 
askin' ya too.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Could ya let us run this fan meetup twice?

text_block_list.name: Event Organizer
text_block_list.text:
O-Of course! I will go make the 
arrangements right away!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, on short notice, the fan meetup 
was held across two separate sessions—

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Was that the last person? ...Thank 
goodness, we managed to make everyone 
smile.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Man, seein' 'em that happy ends up givin' 
us energy too. Feels pretty darn good!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
You betcha! And that's all thanks to Oguri 
diggin' her heels in and negotiatin' for 
us. Much obliged!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Tama, Inari... No, thank you both.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Driven by Oguri Cap's conviction, the fan 
meetup concluded as an overwhelming 
success.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Was that the last person? ...Thank 
goodness, we managed to make... everyone 
smi... le...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (*Grumbleeeeeee*)

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
A-Aw crap, Oguri's hit her limit! 
Somebody~! Bring some grub over here, 
stat~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After powering through two full fan 
meetups, Oguri Cap had completely expended 
all her energy.
